exceptions.title: respects finalFocus when initialFocus points outside the popup
exceptions.reason: With `modal` set to `true`, the elements outside the popup are inert (BUG-4678), so `initialFocus` cannot focus an element outside the popup. The case `BUG-4678: keeps the initial focus off an inert element, and returns the focus to $name` tests this, and the return of the focus.

exceptions.title: moves final focus to trigger if initialFocus points outside the popup and finalFocus is not specified
exceptions.reason: With `modal` set to `true`, the elements outside the popup are inert (BUG-4678), so `initialFocus` cannot focus an element outside the popup. The case `BUG-4678: keeps the initial focus off an inert element, and returns the focus to $name` tests this, and the return of the focus.

exceptions.title: should not throw "Maximum update depth exceeded" when Suspense boundary is outside Portal
exceptions.reason: The case guards a render loop of React (issue 3695) while a `Suspense` boundary outside the portal waits for a lazy component in the popup. The portal of Vase UI renders its content after the mount, so a Vue `<Suspense>` around it does not wait for that content and shows no fallback.
